incidents-bot: [ALERT P1] NLB healthcheck flapping observed in euc2a — significant target churn and downstream 5xx/502 responses. Detector: nlb-healthcheck-monitor at 2026-03-14T21:05:22Z.
Oncall SRE - Mike: I'm on the page. seeing the pager, joining. any initial customer impact reports?
Jess (customer-success): getting CS tickets — some EU customers reporting intermittent API errors and timeouts, reports up to ~40% error rate for a few endpoints.
Anya P: grafana (ingress-proxy / nlb-targets) shows spike in 5xx starting ~21:03 and target deregistration bursts in target-group nlb-prod-euc2a.
Tim (netops): pulling cloudwatch, i'm seeing health check latency spikes and repeated `TargetDeregistered` events for multiple targets in the same AZ.
Oncall SRE - Mike: ok, priority: isolate AZ, reduce customer impact, restore healthy capacity. Steps: confirm whether this is NLB healthchecks or envoy sidecars resetting connections.
eng-runtime-bot: envoys in euc2a report repeated `upstream_reset: connection reset by peer` and `14: connection closed` around same timeframe.
Anya P: running quick target health check: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:...:targetgroup/nlb-prod/abcd1234` -> ~60% unhealthy in euc2a, others steady.
Tim (netops): checking recent infra events — looks like autoscaler scaled nodes in euc2a at 21:02, kubelet readiness toggles visible. possible probe timing/race.
Oncall SRE - Mike: good lead. check kube events for node drain/termination and any kube-probe changes.
Anya P: `kubectl get events -n prod --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 20` shows multiple `Readiness probe failed` then `Killing` entries starting 21:02 — nodes cycling.
Oncall SRE - Mike: mitigation plan: 1) remove euc2a from traffic by setting routing weight to 0, 2) drain/cordon nodes cleanly in that AZ, 3) restart envoy sidecars to clear stale connections, 4) reintroduce AZ gradually.
Tim (netops): i'm going to adjust NLB target group so new connections don't land in euc2a. applying `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:... --attributes Key=load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled,Value=true` and then we'll set weight in our router.
Oncall SRE - Mike: running router command: `rdwctl route set-weight --az euc2a --weight 0` now (no dry-run). monitoring traffic shift.
Jess (customer-success): preparing comms: sending initial note to affected customers and CS queue with acknowledgement + ETA.
eng-runtime-bot: initiated `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/envoy -n prod --selector=topology.kubernetes.io/zone=euc2a`, restarting sidecars in euc2a now (6 pods). logs show reconnects and then normal handshake.
Anya P: after restart, nlb target health improves — 85% healthy @21:10, 98% @21:12. 5xx rate back to baseline by 21:15.
Tim (netops): rebalanced AZ weights to 20% then 50% and monitoring — no regression so far.
Oncall SRE - Mike: impact summary: ~20 minutes of elevated customer errors concentrated in EU region while euc2a targets were flapping due to node readiness churn. Root cause suspected: node autoscaler + kube-probe timing race causing transient probe failures and rapid deregister.
Oncall SRE - Mike: immediate actions taken: drained AZ traffic, restarted envoy sidecars in euc2a, adjusted NLB target behavior to reduce churn, coordinated CS comms.
Oncall SRE - Mike: post-incident action items: [1] add alert for target deregister spikes and probe-failure bursts, [2] investigate kube-probe timing vs autoscaler interplay and increase probe stability, [3] document quick AZ-drain runbook for NLB-backed services, [4] validate node scaling lifecycle with platform-autoscaler. Assigning owners in follow-up.
Jess (customer-success): logged customer outreach and case numbers in support tracker, will follow-up after postmortem.
Anya P: saved logs/dumps to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1958004322/nlb-healthprobe-race/ for postmortem.
Oncall SRE - Mike: thanks everyone. I'll file the incident report and schedule the follow-up. If any new symptoms, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 2026-03-14T21:25:00Z — duration 00:19:38.
